text.en: On a holiday the toy shop opens at 9. All the toys wait to see who will be bought.

On a holiday the market is full of people. The toy shop opens at 9 a.m., and the toys wait to see who will buy them.
Toys of many kinds are there: wooden toys, soft toys, board games, bats and balls.
The toy kitten shouts when two girls come. But they only look through the window and go away, and the toys say Oh no!
Then a girl, a little boy and their father stop. The girl chooses the board game Snakes and Ladders.
A woman and her son come in. A talking doll hopes to be chosen. The little boy points at the toy Vande Bharat train, and his mother buys it.
The toys feel excited and sad as each child chooses. This story lets us imagine toys with feelings.
New words: shopkeeper, rack, window, excitement.
